# String To Byte Array

![String To Byte Array function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/conversion/05-string-to-byte-array.svg)

[Array functions](../overview.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

## Types and connection rules

A scalar String produces a one-dimensional U8 array.

- Type resolution: `custom_resolver`; result expression: `resolve:frog.studio.polymorphic.type-resolution@1`.
- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `none`.

**Input count:** 1; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

## Examples

These are real `.frog` documents from the same index used by Studio. Backend names and expected results describe the examples; they are not execution certificates.

- [String bytes retain UTF-8 and NUL](../../../examples/array.bytes.utf8-nul.md) — This is a byte conversion, not Unicode character indexing. é, NUL and A produce bytes 195, 169, 0, 65. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [Reverse bytes without repairing UTF-8](../../../examples/string.reverse.binary-intermediate.md) — Reverse moves bytes, not Unicode characters. Reversing the UTF-8 encoding of é creates bytes 169, 195. The next real function reads this binary intermediate as U8; no invalid UTF-8 string is saved as a literal. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
